items.title: 52222_Marshall Royal oral history interview
items.q: he was -- I was the first guy that he gave a job out there as a black guy, working with the regular studio orchestra.

ctx.x: (Inaudible) the first regularly employed black musician in television here was Buddy Collette, wasn't it? On the Groucho Marx Show?
He took the Groucho Marx show because I

couldn't play flute. The fellow that was the leader of that, the music director, had hired me first as sub for Skeets Herford (PHONETIC) on the Hardy Family series, which was radio. At the time of the amalgamation of the locals, that's when pressure started coming in for black guys to get some of the work. The fellow that was the leader of this -- you can think of his name right now. He -- his name actually was Jerry Fielding (PHONETIC). Jerry Fielding was one of the guys that fostered the getting together of…
